descriptions: Muffled sounds behind walls
Auto reverb in tunnels, caves, car parks and interiors
Sound leaks through open doors, cuts off when closed
Vehicle interior muffles outside sound by doors, windows and roof
Underwater sound effects
Doppler shift on fast-moving sources
Ear ringing after nearby explosions
Auto music ducking during calls, pause menu and death
Distance falloff follows the game's curve
One sound plays from up to 8 speakers
Area-based sound fills rooms instead of a single point
Adjustable sound bleed from areas
Synced song playback across all players
Drift corrected via inaudible speed trim
Mid-song joiners start at the correct position
In-game editor via /surroundcreator
Place sounds, speakers, room footprints and reverb areas
Edit engine settings in-game
Export placed sounds as pasteable code
Walk around and test without losing work
Space presets: nightclub, bar, lounge, beach, concert, carmeet. One line in your config turns a single-point sound into a full venue
Multi-speaker emitter rings for venues.
Automatic room fill: music fills the interior it plays in, no setup needed.
New exports: setSpacePreset, setEmitterRing
Interior/portal filter now works when listening from outside a venue
Sound no longer disappears completely after walking out of a door
Late joiners now hear sounds that were already playing
